purpose: A new synthetic challenge set created after the v1 parser iteration to probe generalisation beyond the original phrase set.
limitations: All messages are synthetic and manually authored by the project author.
This is a fresh author-created challenge set, not an independently sampled production dataset.
External LLM calls are disabled; results measure the offline rules-first path and workflow behaviour only.
A passing result does not establish real-world generalisation or clinical safety.
